notes.title: Special announcement 2: stepbystep
notes.notes:
The development of stepbystep is finished and the game will be available on November 22.
stepbystep is a minimalistic programming puzzle platformer with experimental turn-based mechanics where you must write a command sequence to complete the leves that will be run automatically. 

Steam store page: [url=store.steampowered.com/app/972940/stepbystep]stepbystep[/url]

Hope you will enjoy.

notes.title: Special announcement: iterform
notes.notes:
My new game is releasing on 12 June and it's called iterform.
It has similar style, but very different mechanic. It is a platformer where you can fix your position to create a replica and teleport on top of the previous one (or start, if there were no replicas) and then use them to move and jump to/from.
The game is based on my ludum dare 34 game GreenGrow.  

Hope you will enjoy.
Store page: [url=store.steampowered.com/app/873210/iterform/] iterform [/url]
Gameplay video on YouTube: [url=www.youtube.com/watch?v=vSMz66MhyPU] iterform [/url]
